香港城市大学语言及翻译学系于5月19日成功举办了“2026语言及翻译创新展”，由Charles B. Chang教授主持👏。该活动汇集了整个部门的教师和学生，为博士生提供了一个宝贵的学术平台来展示和交流思想。LT学生通过海报展示了他们的前沿研究成果，包括神经语言学、语音人工智能、第二语言习得、法律语言学、跨文化语义学等。通过深入的讨论，学生们的研究能力大大提高
LT CityUHK (Department of Linguistics and Translation, City University of Hong Kong) successfully held the 2026 LT Innovation Showcase on 19 May, chaired by Prof. Charles B. Chang👏. Bringing together faculty and students across the department, the event offered a valuable academic platform for PhD students to present and exchange ideas. LT students showcased their cutting-edge research via poster presentations, covering neurolinguistics, speech AI, second language acquisition, legal linguistics, cross-cultural semantics, etc. Through in-depth discussions, students greatly enhanced their research, analytical, and academic communication skills. This event demonstrated our strong commitment to nurturing high-level research talents.
